{{Quote|This is the Valley of Floating Trees! The Tree of Light is on the other side.|Weechee Warrick|<ref name="The Tree of Light">{{Ewoks|The Tree of Light}}</ref>}}
The '''Valley of Floating Trees''' was a clouded valley on the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was filled with trees floating on small islands. [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] had to cross the valley to reach the [[Tree of Light]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
